description: Create a new Proton label. Pass the bare label name (e.g. "Important") — the tool prepends the "Labels/" namespace internally. Labels are non-exclusive tags: a message can carry many labels in addition to living in one folder. Apply or remove labels on messages with `update_message_labels`. Idempotent — succeeds silently if the label already exists.

name.description: Bare label name (e.g. "Important", "Work"). Do not include the "Labels/" prefix.

name: create_label
